name: Index Trend-Day Continuation
hypothesis: Intraday momentum: an index that has moved >=0.45 daily ATR from its cash open two hours into the session and trades in the outer quarter of the session range tends to extend into the cash close.
risk_model: One planned risk unit; fixed 0.30 daily-ATR stop; one decision per index per day; flat 15 minutes before the cash close; no overnight exposure.
known_limitations: No verified edge. DST computed arithmetically (US/EU rules); broker holiday calendar unverified; CFD spread proxies; three highly correlated indices.

authorship.statement: Created by this actual Claude Code session; not attributed to Codex or Kimi.
